Delete Report Configuration (Custom Apps)
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/bi/api/v1/reports/:report_type/:id

Delete a report configuration. Currently only report_type "customapps" is supported.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
report_type
string
REQUIRED

Possible values: [customapps]

Type of report. Currently only "customapps" is supported.

id
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the report configuration.

Responses
​
200
400
401
403
405
429
500

Report configuration deleted successfully.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
default
SCHEMA
message
string
id
int32
